compliance_decision:
1. Inspectors are permitted to request documentation relating to STRs during an inspection as part of their general powers under the FIC Act, specifically section 45B(2).
2. Section 45B(2) - Powers of inspectors in terms of Sections 45A and B of the Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FIC Act), South Africa.
3. Inspectors may request documentation relating to STRs as part of their inspection powers, which includes accessing areas where such documents are stored for compliance verification under section 29 report information receipt procedures by an inspector from a supervisory body within the FIC Act framework in South Africa (Source: PCC 42 - Section 3.3).
4. Yes
